```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)
library(vegan)
```

# Load data 
```{r}
taxa <- read.csv("../data/mpa_aggregated_long_10-5-22.csv")
tcell <- read.csv("../data/Tcell-senescence_matchedToMicro.csv")
```

# Format
```{r}
taxa <- taxa %>%
  select(Taxonomy, RelAbun, sample)

taxa <- spread(taxa, Taxonomy, RelAbun) %>%
  remove_rownames %>% column_to_rownames(var="sample")

taxa[is.na(taxa)] <- 0
```


# Calculate diversity
```{r}
test <- as.data.frame(diversity(taxa, index = "simpson"))
test$sample <- row.names(test)
test <- test %>%
  rename("diversity" = "diversity(taxa, index = \"simpson\")")
```

# save
```{r}
tcellDiv <- merge(tcell, test)

write.csv(tcellDiv, "../data/diversityTcell.csv", row.names = F)
```
